name: PSE EDGE — listed company directory (OPEN)
note: OPEN. POST form: keyword=&sector=&subsector=&pageNo=&pageSize=50&cmpySortType=ASC&symbolSortType=ASC. Returns HTML rows: company name, stock symbol, sector, subsector, listing date. Verified: PLDT Inc. (TEL). Per-company disclosures + financial reports via cmpy_id. Listed only.

name: SEC Express — company documents (PAID)
note: PAID. Order GIS (officers/stockholders/capital) / AFS (financials) / Articles / certificates per company (PHP). Companies file via eFAST (login). No open bulk/API; sec.gov.ph WAF-blocked. Redact GIS personal data (Data Privacy Act 2012). Do not bypass paywall.

name: DTI BNRS — sole-proprietor business name search (free)
note: Free business-name search/verification for sole proprietorships (not corporations — those are SEC). Issues the DTI BN number. No open bulk.
